bio_en: Hovsep Movsisian (Argam Petrosian) was born in Tabriz in 1870, the son of the carpenter Gabriel Movsisian who often worked in Tiflis, and learned to read at the celebrated Ter-Todikian school. He was a member of Sargis Kukunian's expedition of 1890, whose story he told in 'Memoirs of the Kukunian expedition', serialised in Hairenik monthly from December 1933 to April 1935. He was buried on 29 February 1936.
